# Scanner license texts

These texts are kept with the self-hosted browser scanner. Preserve them and
`../NOTICE.md` when distributing its assets.

PaddleOCR/OpenCV/js-yaml and additional npm dependency notices were copied from
the installed, lockfile-pinned packages or vendored SDK source. ONNX Runtime's
npm archive omits its top-level LICENSE, so its MIT text and third-party
notices were copied from the official v1.22.0 source tag.

Clipper's original author/JSBN attribution header and the full Boost/Tom Wu
terms are retained because minifying the worker removes ordinary source
comments. HEIC wrapper, codec and incorporated GNU terms are supplied in full.
The HEIC source declarations and matching source archives are documented in
`../source/README.md`.

Remote notice/source retrieval URLs and checksums are in
`../source/manifest.json`. Runtime model origins and hashes are recorded
separately in `../models/manifest.json`.
